title: Hemagglutination Test (HAT) to detect antibodies against the RBD domain of the SARS2-Covid19 virus
protocol: Plate out 50 µL of 1:20 serum/plasma in alternate columns 1,3,5,7,9,11.
Add 2.5 µL sample to 47.5 µL PBS for each well.
Add 50 µL 1:20 O-ve blood collected to dilute the sample to 1:40 and red cells at ~1% v/v.
Mix and transfer 50/100 µL to neighbouring columns 2,4,6,8,10,12 for negative controls.
Add 50 µL IH4-RBD reagent (2 µg/mL in PBS = 100 ng/well) to Columns 1,3,5,7,9,11.
Add 50 µL PBS to columns 2,4,6,8,10,12.
Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature.
Tilt the plate for 30 seconds.
Photograph the plate using a mobile phone with zoom function to obtain a complete field view.
Read as Positive = No teardrop, Negative <1:40 = partial teardrop, Neg = complete teardrop.
Two readers should read the plates independently.
Resolve disagreements by taking the lesser reading.
Dilute samples to 1:20 in 50 μL PBS (2.5 μL sample and 47.5 μL PBS) in V-bottomed plate in Rows A-H, column 1.
Prepare WHO standard serum 20/130 at a dilution of 1:20 for calibration.
Dilute samples across the plate columns 1-11 with PBS (1:40 to 1:40,960), and prepare a PBS control in column 12.
Add 50 μL 1% v/v O-ve red cells to all wells.
Mix 50 μL 1:40 O-ve red cells with 50 μL IH4-RBD (2 μg/mL) and add to all wells.
Allow the red cells to settle for 1 hour.
Tilt plate for at least 30 seconds and photograph. The titre is defined by the last well in which the tear drop fails to form.
Clean hands and warm the digit.
Label a 96-well V-bottomed plate with date and time.
Prick the skin on the outer finger pulp with a disposable lancet.
Wipe away the first drop of blood with a sterile towel or swab.
Massage to produce a second drop of blood.
Take a minimum of 5 µL blood with a 20 µL pipette.
Mix immediately into 20 µL K2EDTA (3.6 mg/mL/PBS) in an Eppendorf tube.
Alternatively, take 25 µL of blood and mix into 100 µL K2EDTA solution.
For a 5 µL sample, dilute to 200 µL with PBS (add 175 µL PBS).
For a 25 µL sample, dilute to 1 mL (add 975 µL PBS).
Plate 50 µL x 3 in V-bottomed microtitre wells labelled T (Test), + (PC, positive Control), - (NC, negative control).
Add 10 µL of control anti RBD Mab CR3022 (2 µg/mL stock in PBS, 20 ng/well) to the “+” well.
Add 50 µL IH4-RBD (2 µg/mL in PBS) to the “T” (Test) and “+ve” wells.
Add 50 µL PBS to the “-ve” well.
Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature to form a pellet in the “-ve” well.
Tilt plate against a well-lit white background for approximately 30 seconds to allow tear drop formation in the “-ve” well.
Photograph the plate to record results with date and time.
Include a negative (PBS) control on every sample for comparison.
Include a positive control induced by CR3022 in every batch of samples to check reagent functionality.
Remove red cells from the remaining 850 µL of 1:40 diluted blood after taking a 25 μL sample.
Use a preparation of 1:40 O-ve red cells for titration as described.
